name: Creatures on display ids above 65535 keep their own display
contract: Creature model data was keyed by a 16-bit id, so display 142832 (troglodyte, Grimepit Trogg 164206) read the row
of 142832 % 65536 = 11760, a troll female paired with troll male 11758. Each spawn then had a 50% chance, rolled
twice on creation, of switching to a troll display. Expected: every summoned Grimepit Trogg stays on 142832.
Goldshire Farmer 162824 wears a captured female look; her display must not be one of a male/female pair, so every
summoned farmer stays on the plain human female display 50. display_id reads the server's display only.
